GNU libgomp 8.5.0 (AlmaLinux package 8.5.0-29.el8_10.alma.1).

Corresponding source, including distribution patches and build instructions:
https://repo.almalinux.org/vault/8.10/BaseOS/Source/Packages/gcc-8.5.0-29.el8_10.alma.1.src.rpm

The libgomp.so.1 supplied with DIA-NN is the copy packaged by PyTorch in
LibTorch 2.15.0+cpu for Linux. PyTorch sets the library search path to
$ORIGIN so that the loader can find libraries in the same directory.
The AlmaLinux source package above contains the runtime source and patches.
PyTorch publishes its packaging instructions at:
https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/d0f2af8b66b20da4baa50644c0cd3f887a2eae2e/.ci/wheel/linux/repair_wheel.py
https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/d0f2af8b66b20da4baa50644c0cd3f887a2eae2e/.ci/libtorch/extract_libtorch_from_wheel.py
